name: w-language-project
description: Design and executable specification workspace for the W language

scripts.tooling:install: bun ci --cwd tooling/tree-sitter-w && bun run --cwd tooling/tree-sitter-w generate
scripts.docs:write: bun tooling/diagnostic-catalog.mjs --write && bun tooling/syntax-atlas.mjs --write && bun tooling/platform-support.mjs --write && bun tooling/dependency-currency.mjs --write && bun tooling/design-index.mjs --write && bun tooling/study-registry.mjs --write && bun tooling/executable-benchmark-docs.mjs --write
